rationale: This draft records a research question without selecting favorable thresholds or authorizing evaluation.

rejection_criteria.rationale: No rejection rule is justified at the infrastructure stage.

leakage_risks: Catalyst records arriving after a signal could be joined retrospectively.

No causal claim or performance improvement is established.
notes: Draft only. Evaluation commands are intentionally unavailable.
hypothesis: The time between first publication and signal generation helps distinguish newly developing moves from stale moves.
comparison_group: Timing groups defined prospectively after timestamp-quality and coverage review.

feature_definitions.name: publication_to_signal_elapsed_minutes
feature_definitions.definition: Elapsed minutes from publication timestamp to signal timestamp; binning remains unresolved.
feature_definitions.availability_time: Publication and signal timestamps must both be known point-in-time, with no future record revisions.

feature_definitions.name: first_seen_to_signal_elapsed_minutes
feature_definitions.definition: Elapsed minutes from collector first-seen timestamp to signal timestamp; binning remains unresolved.
feature_definitions.availability_time: First-seen timestamp must be no later than the signal timestamp.
